responsibility: Implements the persistent ForeverStack namespace tree that backs Resolver2_0 scope management. This file supplies the concrete behavior of ForeverStackStore::Node and the store itself: creating child scope nodes keyed by NodeId and optional path segment, selecting per-namespace Rib tables, inserting ordinary, shadowable, and globbed definitions, traversing parent and child links, locating enclosing module scopes, and searching the preserved scope graph by NodeId so multiple resolver passes can revisit the same lexical structure without discarding earlier ribs.
same_name_distinction: Provides the non-template implementation for the persistent scope store declared in the corresponding header, notably ForeverStackStore::Node and store operations such as child creation, parent/child traversal, namespace-rib selection, insertion, and NodeId lookup.
